QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Perzen's Barrier
QuestInfo.0: You must help Perzen protect Altaire Camp with his Barrier Stone. Go ask him how you can help.
QuestInfo.1: To keep the Barrier Stone strong, you need to collect energy from the forest's living organisms.\nCollect energy from the monsters infesting the forest.
QuestInfo.2: You gave Perzen the materials needed to strengthen the Barrier Stone. Continue to collect materials whenever time permits to help Perzen.

0.0: My, my, don't you look familiar! Oh, but don't worry. Your secret's safe with me. No need to excite everyone here at the camp, eh?\r\n#L0##bSure, sure. But I have to ask... Who is Kao? Everyone talks like they know me...#l\n#k
0.1: Kao's one of the fine folks who ended up here with us. You two look just alike. Kao's quite popular, so don't go ruining the reputation, all right?\r\n#L0##bSo...where is Kao?#l\n#k
0.2: Well, that's the funny part. Kao disappeared suddenly, and then you showed up. I'm sure nothing suspicious happened, though. You look trustworthy. Just like Kao!\r\n#L0##b(You want to ask more, but maybe it's better not to...)#l\n#k

yes.0: The Barrier Stone protects the camp from dark energy. There's a LOT of dark energy, though, so my barrier's getting weaker every day. I can reinforce the barrier with life energy from the monsters attacking us. Fight fire with fire, right? Get me 30 Forest Stones from the monsters in this forest, and we're set.

no.0: Sure, sure. I know you'll help eventually. Just have to wait until you're in the right mood, right?

yes.0: Thank you so much. Your help has assured the safety of the whole camp. For today, anyway...

default.0: Please bring me 30 Forest Stones. They're the extra-evil stones.
